tasks.title: Essay: Prioritising public health campaigns
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: Your class has listened to a radio discussion about how a public health equity plan should allocate funding to local health campaigns. You have made the notes below.

promptBlocks.heading: Priorities for public health campaigns
listItems: targeted screening programmes for high-risk groups

paragraphs: Screening programmes catch diseases early and save lives, but they only reach people who already engage with healthcare.
Exercise initiatives build long-term health and social connections, yet they require sustained funding and participation.
Awareness campaigns are cheap and wide-reaching, but they rarely change behaviour on their own.

promptBlocks.text: Write an essay for your tutor discussing two of the priorities in your notes. You should explain which priority you think is more important for the public health equity plan to invest in, giving reasons in support of your answer. You may, if you wish, make use of the opinions expressed in the discussion, but you should use your own words as far as possible.

tasks.title: Proposal: Community exercise programme
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: Your local health authority is planning to launch a community-based exercise initiative aimed at adults who are currently inactive. The authority has invited proposals from community groups for how this initiative should be designed.

Write a proposal for the health authority. In your proposal, you should:

• recommend two specific types of exercise activities the initiative should offer
• explain how these activities would benefit participants and the wider community
• suggest how the authority could ensure the initiative reaches those who are least active

tasks.title: Email: Nutrition campaign concerns
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: You are a community health worker for a public health equity plan. The programme coordinator has emailed you about a proposal to launch a nutrition awareness campaign that would use social media influencers to promote healthy eating. Some colleagues are concerned that this approach may oversimplify nutritional advice and could be misleading.

Write an email to the programme coordinator. In your email, you should:

• explain your position on using social media influencers for the campaign
• analyse one potential implication for public understanding of nutrition
• propose an action the plan could take to address concerns while still reaching a wide audience

tasks.title: Review: Health screening event
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: You see this announcement on a local community website.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted: Health screening events
paragraphs: Have you attended a free health screening event organised by the public health equity plan? We want to hear about your experience.

Write a review for our website. Describe the event and what it offered. Evaluate how well it balanced reaching people with convenience and providing thorough health information. Would you recommend this type of event to other communities? Why or why not?
The best reviews will be published on our website.
